Description

For Research Use Only. Not for human or veterinary use. Not for use in diagnostic or therapeutic procedures. Not approved by the FDA or any regulatory body for human consumption, treatment, cure, or prevention of any disease.

IGF-1 LR3 is a synthetic peptide analog supplied for in-vitro research into IGF-1 receptor agonism and related cellular signaling pathways.

In research settings, IGF-1 LR3 is studied for its modified binding-protein affinity and extended systemic presence, particularly in models evaluating IGF-1 receptor autophosphorylation and downstream PI3K/Akt and MAPK signaling cascades.
